combo.description: When ganking R then E towards your target, positioning yourself to Q stun your target once out of stasis.
To catch out opponents, lead with R then throw Q out right before they come out of stasis.
To reposition your Q, cast Q and instantly Flash.
Your basic trade will be Q in between AAs
When roaming E then go through it and Q your target.
